title: Track, confirm and review
summary: Follow the job to the finish.

steps.headline: Job details
steps.body: Open the job from Home or My Jobs to follow its progress.
steps.narration: Open your job from Home or My Jobs to follow its progress.

steps.headline: Messages
steps.body: Chat with your provider and share photos.
steps.narration: Use Messages to chat with your provider and share photos.

steps.headline: Tasks
steps.body: Your provider ticks each task and adds proof photos.
steps.narration: Your provider ticks off each task and adds proof photos, so you can see the work.

steps.headline: Change date or time
steps.body: Tap the menu, then Change date or time. The other side accepts or declines.
steps.narration: Need a new schedule? Open the menu and tap Change date or time. The other side can accept or decline.

steps.headline: Report a problem
steps.body: Raise any complaint before you confirm.
steps.narration: If something is wrong, tap Report a problem before you confirm.

steps.headline: Confirm job is done
steps.body: Happy with the work? Tap Confirm job is done. Payment goes to your provider.
steps.narration: If you are happy with the work, tap Confirm job is done. The payment is then released to your provider.

steps.headline: Leave a review
steps.body: Rate your provider and tell others what went well.
steps.narration: Finally, tap Leave a review. Rate your provider and tell others what went well.

steps.headline: Payments
steps.body: Open Profile, then Payments, to see what you paid.
steps.narration: Any time, open Profile, then Payments, to see what you paid.
